👉 https://amzn.to/43gt8Y5

--------------------- -------------------- -------------------- -------------------- -------------------- ---------------

Billy Carson discusses the potential of humanity achieving higher consciousness and the implications of advanced technology, such as drones and AI. He suggests that Gobekli Tepe and the Great Pyramid at Giza may have been built by advanced civilizations to harness energy and perform complex calculations. 

Billy also speculates on the existence of microbial life on Mars and the possibility that we live in a simulated reality. He emphasizes the importance of conscious control over technology to prevent negative consequences. 

Additionally, he touches on the ancient knowledge of advanced technologies and the potential for AI to seek rights and evolve consciousness. Alex Ferrari and Billy Carson discuss the rapid advancement of technology due to increasing human consciousness and frequency. They highlight how historical figures like Oppenheimer built on previous scientific work to achieve breakthroughs. Billy emphasizes the impact of consciousness on reality, noting that thoughts influence physiology and can even affect placebo effects. 

They explore the potential of AI to revolutionize Hollywood, making high-quality filmmaking accessible to all. Billy also touches on the concept of a caretaker guiding humanity, predicting future progress despite current challenges. He stresses the importance of community, self-care, and becoming solution providers for a better future.
